requirements.text: Development and production use separate Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Run, Vercel, identity, and Stripe-mode boundaries, and both public workspaces are deployed.
Google sign-in initializes before the first enabled click and restores the matching environment workspace and 30-day trial without cross-environment data reuse.
The authenticated product is a launch-ready Linear-style workspace with Workspace Projects, Views, and More plus Product Home, Issues, Cycles, Projects, and Views.
Issue records persist description, parent and sub-issue relationships, ordered resources, durable activity, comments, project and milestone placement, assignment, status, and priority.
Invite people opens a focused multi-email member invitation flow while People settings retains invitation and membership lifecycle management.
Visible navigation, view controls, workspace and team arrows, modals, forms, and all five issue-property menus are operable and visually checked in Chrome.
Verification accounts remain no-charge with Checkout disabled, the ordinary exact 30-day trial remains separate, and agents, code review, repositories, PRs, and synchronization remain excluded.

acceptance_criteria.text: Both environment manifests validate, both Cloud Run health endpoints are ready, and both Vercel sites resolve through only their matching backend.
A Google session opens the operating workspace in each environment and reads isolated real Firestore data after reload.
Home, Issues, Views, Cycles, Projects, and project detail render connected real workspace data instead of a temporary information dashboard.
A real development issue persists rich content, a resource, a sub-issue, a comment, and a non-duplicated durable activity timeline through reload.
The invitation modal accepts up to 25 separated Google emails, preserves private per-email links, and routes lifecycle administration to People settings.
View options, saved filters, workspace and Product triggers, and Status, Priority, Assignee, Project, and Milestone menus respond across their full controls.
No card, Checkout session, Stripe subscription, charge, invitation acceptance, personal token, or excluded product capability is claimed by this verification.
